params.name: valueArray
params.description: Web form variable values, synchronized index-for-index with nameArray.

overloads.semanticRole: The WEB GET VARIABLES command fills the text arrays nameArray and valueArray with the variable names and values contained in the Web form “submitted” (i.e.

constraints: Valid regardless of whether the submitted form/URL used the POST or GET method.
For checkboxes, a name/value pair is only returned if the checkbox was actually checked.
